keyFeatures: 48-question assessment yielding your 3-letter RIASEC Holland Code
Scores across six types: Realistic, Investigative, Artistic, Social, Enterprising, and Conventional
One of the most widely used career assessment frameworks — used by the US Department of Labor
Career path and work environment recommendations matched to your Holland Code combination
tips: Your 3-letter code represents your top three types — the order matters, with the first letter being your strongest interest area.
Use your Holland Code alongside your Strengths Assessment for a fuller picture: RIASEC tells you what environments you thrive in, while Strengths tells you what you're naturally good at.
